findings.claim: FTC 於 2024-04-23 起訴阻止 Tapestry 收購 Capri（約 85 億美元），法院其後核准初步禁制令，交易被擋下；屬過往併購反壟斷案，非對 TPR 現有業務的調查。
findings.source: WUSTL Law Review: Is Dealmaking Going Out of Fashion? The Impact of the FTC-Tapestry, Inc. Litigation on M&A Activity in the Fashion Industry
findings.excerpt: following an investigation and 5-0 approval vote by FTC commissioners, the FTC sued on April 23, 2024.

findings.claim: 法學評論稱 FTC 勝訴形成先例，可能限制「輕奢」層級未來的併購整合。
findings.excerpt: The FTC's successful challenge of the Capri merger has set a precedent that will likely limit future consolidation within the "accessible luxury" tier.

regulatory_antitrust.note: 未找到 DOJ／FTC／歐盟對 TPR 現有業務的新調查或拆分風險；搜尋結果只出現 Capri 併購案。關稅相關結果（約 1.6 億美元 FY2026 成本）有出現，但搜尋摘要未附發布日期，且屬貿易而非反壟斷，未列入。摘要句為搜尋工具轉述，非頁面原文。
